member_ref.description: The identifier used to locate the member. On cascade this is the ten-digit account number, not the member ID.

chain.notes: Second textbox on the search form, after Last Name. Position only.

notes: Cascade runs the same CoreServ product on a later build with different configuration. Three things differ and each is expressible as an override: the search field's label, the results grid's leading column header, and what the identifier parameter actually means -- cascade searches by account number, so the same capability takes a ten-digit value here. results_view_link deliberately needs NO override: its row scope matches on {{member_ref}}, and each tenant's grid displays whichever identifier that tenant searches by, so the same chain resolves in both. Note that cascade's grid renders the member's FIRST account number, so a reference to some other account of the same member would find the record but fail to match the displayed row; the example value is chosen accordingly.
